title: Certified Multi-Turn Robustness for LLM Safety via Compositional Bounds and Safety Persistence
abstract: arXiv:2608.20820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are vulnerable to multi-turn jailbreak attacks that progressively manipulate conversation context. Existing certified robustness methods are limited to single-turn inputs; naive multi-turn composition yields bounds that degrade exponentially in the number of turns. We introduce Multi-Turn Certified Robustness (MTCR), a framework that models conversational safety via State-Adversarial MDPs and defines $k$-turn certified robustness as the worst-case safety probability across $k$ adversarial turns. MTCR comprises: (i) compositional certification via embedding-space mode decomposition, yielding tighter certified lower bounds than naive multiplication; (ii) $(\alpha,\beta)$-safety persistence, improving the degradation rate from $\underline{p}^{k}$ to $\beta^k$ (with $\beta > \underline{p}$) and yielding interpretable horizon estimates; (iii) matching information-theoretic upper bounds establishing tightness; and

translated_title: 面向大语言模型安全性的多轮认证鲁棒性：基于组合界与安全持久性方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型容易受到多轮越狱攻击，这类攻击通过逐步操纵对话上下文来突破安全限制。现有的认证鲁棒性方法仅适用于单轮输入；简单组合多轮方法会导致认证界随轮数呈指数级恶化。我们引入了多轮认证鲁棒性（MTCR）框架，该框架通过状态对抗马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）对对话安全性进行建模，并将k轮认证鲁棒性定义为在k轮对抗性交互中的最坏情况安全概率。MTCR包含三个核心组件：（i）通过嵌入空间模态分解实现组合认证，产生比简单乘法更紧致的认证下界；（ii）引入(α,β)-安全持久性，将退化率从p^k提升至β^k（其中β > p），并提供可解释的时域估计；（iii）匹配的信息论上界，确保紧致性。
tldr: 本文提出MTCR框架，通过状态对抗MDP建模对话安全，利用模态分解和(α,β)-安全持久性显著改善多轮认证界退化，并给出信息论紧致上界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MTCR, a framework modeling conversational safety via state-adversarial MDPs, leveraging mode decomposition and (α,β)-safety persistence to significantly improve multi-turn certification bound degradation, with matching information-theoretic upper bounds ensuring tightness.
